title: Hacker News Thread on OpenAI’s ‘Apple Is Getting This Wrong’ Post
content_html:
Hacker News Thread on OpenAI’s ‘Apple Is Getting This Wrong’ Post

There’s an old adage that you should never bring a knife to a gunfight. My take on OpenAI’s response yesterday was expressing incredulity that OpenAI was bringing, like, a box of chocolates to the gunfight. Apple is trying to kill io, and OpenAI’s public response is basically “We love you guys, can’t we just be friends?”

This thread on Hacker News though points out that their response doesn’t even explain what they’re responding to. There’s no context. They just assume the reader is up to date on the lawsuit Apple filed. If you didn’t know anything about the suit and started with this post, it would make no sense at all. I’ve heard from friends there that the OpenAI culture is “too online”, and this might be the best proof of it.

★ Wednesday, 5 August 2026

content_html_zh:
OpenAI 的“苹果搞错了”帖子中的黑客新闻主题
有一句古老的格言说，枪战中永远不应该带刀。 我对 OpenAI 昨天的回应表示怀疑，认为 OpenAI 会在枪战中带来一盒巧克力之类的东西。 苹果试图消灭 io，而 OpenAI 的公开回应基本上是“我们爱你们，我们就不能只是做朋友吗？” 不过，黑客新闻上的这篇帖子指出，他们的回应甚至没有解释他们的回应是什么。 没有上下文。 他们只是假设读者了解苹果提起的诉讼的最新情况。 如果你对这套衣服一无所知并从这篇文章开始，那就毫无意义了。 我听那里的朋友说OpenAI文化“太在线”，这或许就是最好的证明。 ★ 2026 年 8 月 5 日，星期三
